einzeiler: The behind-the-scenes saga of bringing A Court of Thorns and Roses to the screen.
kurzfassung: The television adaptation of Sarah J. Maas's book series A Court of Thorns and Roses faced numerous delays and was ultimately canceled by Hulu in early 2025. Following the cancellation, Maas successfully reclaimed the rights to her work to protect her creative vision. Currently, the project remains in development as industry figures and fans speculate on its future.
stichpunkte: Hulu canceled the television adaptation of A Court of Thorns and Roses in February 2025.
Showrunner Ronald D. Moore attributed the failure to COVID-19 delays, industry strikes, and Disney's corporate restructuring under Bob Iger.
Sarah J. Maas successfully let the option rights lapse and reclaimed full control of her intellectual property.
Maas demands strict creative control and rejects studio demographic adjustments.
Margot Robbie's production company, Lucky Chap Entertainment, has been linked to potential involvement following a meeting with Maas.
Maas's upcoming publishing schedule means an adaptation timeline will likely extend toward late 2028 or 2029.
The fandom views the property as part of an interconnected literary universe known as the Maasverse.
beschreibung:
The episode discusses the current status of the television adaptation for Sarah J. Maas’ popular book series, A Court of Thorns and Roses. After being in development since 2021, the project was officially canceled by Hulu in early 2025 following several production hurdles and the departure of the original showrunner. Despite this setback, the author has reclaimed the rights to her work and is actively searching for a new network or streaming home for the show. Because the project is essentially starting over, a release date is likely several years away, as Maas is currently prioritizing the completion of her upcoming novels. While no official cast has been selected, the article highlights significant fan theories and potential interest from high-profile figures like Margot Robbie.
